QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: altitudeStep
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Altitude change per W or S key press. Holding the key repeats the step.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Altitude step

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: turnRate
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Heading change rate while A or D is held. 3 deg/s is a standard-rate turn.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Turn rate

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: turnBankLimit
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Maximum bank angle the aircraft may use to follow a keyboard turn (sent to ArduPlane as an acceleration limit).
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Turn bank limit

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: gimbalRate
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Gimbal pan and tilt rate while an arrow key is held.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Gimbal rate
